name: Cities: Skylines
author: Cell
summary: Runs the Cities: Skylines Paradox Launcher with software rendering under Wine.
useWhen: Cities: Skylines opens a blank Paradox Launcher window.

options.title: Skip Paradox Launcher
options.help: Start Cities directly from Cell if the launcher cannot finish updating.

notes: For Steam’s Library Play button, add --pdxlDisableHardwareAcceleration --pdxlEnableInProcessGpu to this game’s Steam launch options.
